stem:
Padma plants a short stem cutting from a money plant in soil. Weeks later a new plant grows from that cutting.

How was the new plant produced?

options.text: By vegetative propagation, because a new plant grew from a part of one parent plant.
By seeds formed after mixing instructions from two parent plants.
By two parent plants exchanging pollen and making fruit.
By a seedling sprouting from a seed buried in the soil.

teacher.key_rationale: A new plant from a stem cutting is vegetative propagation from one parent. Seeds, pollen exchange, and buried-seed seedlings are different pathways.
